reviewer: modal_route_feasibility with delegated worker_compat admission read-only review

resolved_findings.initial_issue: A passing verifier summary was honored without binding it to the actual native streams and observed target/witness/status counts.
resolved_findings.resolution: Passing summaries now require original-stream or all-exact-parts input hashes and matching target/witness/status totals. Binding findings leave every actual counter/row retained and mark verification error/excluded.

resolved_findings.initial_issue: Raw-manifest protocol and each actual child input-manifest were not explicitly crosschecked.
resolved_findings.resolution: Manifest protocol must match frozen protocol; actual child protocol/input manifest must agree with actual raw/provider context.

resolved_findings.initial_issue: Named image/build-info input pins were not explicitly required to match the frozen route paths and hashes.
resolved_findings.resolution: validate_transport_binding_paths checks exact route paths/hash pins; prospective mode validates actual receipt/build-info and A/B/app/image/binary crossbindings.

resolved_findings.initial_issue: Complete transport could yield parent success for a nonzero engine; copied controller/transport summaries were not checked against archived receipt.
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit operational status preserves command/collected engine returncodes and failed parent state; checker compares duplicate controller metadata and transport consistency to actual archived receipt and recomputes operational status. Scientific validity remains not_assessed.
